dialogues.jp: 「行ってきま〜す」

朝食の時の妙な雰囲気を、まだ引きずっている
のかな？　何だか元気がないように見えたけど
……。
dialogues.en:
Is she still thinking about the conversation we has in the
morning? She looks a bit down......
dialogues.text:
Is she still thinking about the conversation we has in the
morning? She looks a bit down......

dialogues.jp:
歩きながら、玄関に立つ頼子さんの顔を思い浮
かべる。
dialogues.en:
As I walk, I think about the expression she had on her face
at the front door.
dialogues.text:
As I walk, I think about the expression she had on her face
at the front door.

dialogues.jp: あの表情。あれは──。
dialogues.en: The expression. That was......
dialogues.text: The expression. That was......

dialogues.en: (...Lonely?)
dialogues.text: (...Lonely?)

dialogues.jp:
それは、受ける印象の話だった。目も口も、形
としては笑顔を浮かべている。
dialogues.en: Her eyes, mouth, and face were all smiling, but...
dialogues.text: Her eyes, mouth, and face were all smiling, but...

dialogues.jp: （寂しげな笑顔……か）
dialogues.en: (It was a sad smile......)
dialogues.text: (It was a sad smile......)

dialogues.jp: そして、ふと気が付いた。
dialogues.en: And I noticed.
dialogues.text: And I noticed.

dialogues.jp:
頼子さんに送り出されるのは、今朝で四度目。
そして……。
dialogues.en: It was the fourth time she sent me off at the front door.
dialogues.text: It was the fourth time she sent me off at the front door.

dialogues.jp:
そんな印象を受けるのも、今朝で四度目だって
ことに。
dialogues.en: And it was also the fourth time I saw sadness in her smile.
dialogues.text: And it was also the fourth time I saw sadness in her smile.

dialogues.speaker: Suginami
dialogues.jp:
「いよぅっ、朝倉。朝から景気の悪い顔して、
　いかにもお前にお似合いだなっ」
dialogues.en: "Hey, Asakura! You look stagnant as usual."
dialogues.text: "Hey, Asakura! You look stagnant as usual."

dialogues.speaker: Suginami
dialogues.jp: 「お前……この道でかかしでもやってるのか？」
dialogues.en: "Are you...... living on this street or what?"
dialogues.text: "Are you...... living on this street or what?"

dialogues.speaker: Suginami
dialogues.jp: 「ふふふ、もちろんお前を待っていたのだっ」
dialogues.en: "I was just waiting for you."
dialogues.text: "I was just waiting for you."

dialogues.speaker: Suginami
dialogues.jp: 「……やめろ。こら、肩に手を回すなっ」
dialogues.en: "......Stop it. Don't put your hand around my shoulder!"
dialogues.text: "......Stop it. Don't put your hand around my shoulder!"

dialogues.jp: 奴の制空圏から逃れつつ、ため息をつく。
dialogues.en: I step away from him and sigh.
dialogues.text: I step away from him and sigh.

dialogues.jp:
「で？　今日は何だ？　俺のありがたい演説で
　も聞きに来たのか？」
dialogues.en: "So? What do you want? Do you want to hear my opera?"
dialogues.text: "So? What do you want? Do you want to hear my opera?"

dialogues.speaker: Suginami
dialogues.jp: 「本気で話すなら、聞いてやってもいいがな」
dialogues.en: "Ha-ha-ha! Are you gonna try to break my ears?"
dialogues.text: "Ha-ha-ha! Are you gonna try to break my ears?"

dialogues.jp: 考えるまでもなく面倒だし、第一ネタがない。
dialogues.en: "......If that works, I'll really sing it loud for you."
dialogues.text: "......If that works, I'll really sing it loud for you."

dialogues.speaker: Suginami
dialogues.jp: 「ちっちっちっ」
dialogues.en: "If you really want to sing, I will listen."
dialogues.text: "If you really want to sing, I will listen."

dialogues.jp: 杉並が人差し指を立て、左右に振る。

「何か、他のミステリーの話か？　俺は興味な
　いぞ、んなの」
dialogues.en: Come to think of it, it'd be creepy if I really sang opera.
dialogues.text: Come to think of it, it'd be creepy if I really sang opera.

dialogues.speaker: Suginami
dialogues.jp:
「おまえの頭はニワトリさん以下か？　昨日、
　話したことも忘れるとは」
dialogues.en:
"So? What do you want? Do you want to talk about Yoriko-san
again?"
dialogues.text:
"So? What do you want? Do you want to talk about Yoriko-san
again?"

dialogues.speaker: Suginami
dialogues.jp: 「昨日……？　ああ、眞子のことか」
dialogues.en: "No. It's not that."
dialogues.text: "No. It's not that."

dialogues.jp:
そう言えば、放課後にそんな会話を交わしたこ
とを思い出す。
dialogues.en: What? What's wrong with him? He looks so serious......
dialogues.text: What? What's wrong with him? He looks so serious......

dialogues.speaker: Suginami
dialogues.jp: 「昨日、いろいろと調査してみたのだが」
dialogues.en: "Another mysterious story? I'm not interested, you know."
dialogues.text: "Another mysterious story? I'm not interested, you know."

dialogues.speaker: Suginami
dialogues.jp: 「調査ってどんな？」
dialogues.en: "No. It's not...... that, either."
dialogues.text: "No. It's not...... that, either."

dialogues.speaker: Suginami
dialogues.jp:
「さりげなく後を尾けてみたり、双眼鏡で行動
　を監視したりとか」
dialogues.en: He takes a moment to reply back.
dialogues.text: He takes a moment to reply back.

dialogues.jp:
世間の一般常識だと、そういうのはストーカー
と言わないか？
dialogues.en:
(He looks serious even though it's not about mysterious
things......?)
dialogues.text:
(He looks serious even though it's not about mysterious
things......?)

dialogues.jp:
そう指摘しても風のように無視されることは確
実だろうから、とりあえずバカの言うことに耳
を傾けておく。
dialogues.en: It's not like him at all......
dialogues.text: It's not like him at all......

dialogues.jp: ……また、よからぬことを考えてるな。
dialogues.en: "Then what is it?"
dialogues.text: "Then what is it?"

dialogues.speaker: Suginami
dialogues.jp: 「名付けて“北風と太陽さん大作戦！”だ」

眞子でなくても、野次馬根性丸出しのおまえに
は何も話さんと思うが……。
dialogues.en: He looks away and says,
dialogues.text: He looks away and says,

dialogues.speaker: Suginami
dialogues.jp:
「そこでだ。元気づけという名目で気分転換に
　誘い出し、言葉巧みに悩み事を聞き出すとい
　う作戦だ」
dialogues.en: "What do you think I should do to cheer up Mako?"
dialogues.text: "What do you think I should do to cheer up Mako?"

dialogues.jp:
……コイツは絶対にロクな死に方をしないな。
俺はそう確信した。
「なあ、ひとつだけ訊いていいか？」
dialogues.en:
"......Oops, sorry. Some weird electric wave caused a noise
in my ears. Can you say that again?"
dialogues.text:
"......Oops, sorry. Some weird electric wave caused a noise
in my ears. Can you say that again?"

dialogues.speaker: Suginami
dialogues.jp: 「何だ？」
dialogues.en: "What do you think I should do to cheer up Mako?"
dialogues.text: "What do you think I should do to cheer up Mako?"

dialogues.speaker: Suginami
dialogues.jp:
「なぜ、おまえがそこまでするんだ？　眞子が
　何を悩んで落ち込んでいるかはおまえと関係
　ないだろう」

dialogues.speaker: Suginami
dialogues.jp:
「はぁ〜。朝倉よ。おまえはまだこの俺の崇高
　な目的がわかっていないな」
dialogues.en: "Did you forget about yesterday already?"
dialogues.text: "Did you forget about yesterday already?"

dialogues.jp: いや、わかりたくもないんだけど……。
dialogues.en:
"I remember she was a bit down, but I don't understand why
you want to cheer her up. It's weird, you know."
dialogues.text:
"I remember she was a bit down, but I don't understand why
you want to cheer her up. It's weird, you know."

dialogues.speaker: Suginami
dialogues.jp:
「俺が動くのは、水越のためなどという｛ひしょう／卑小｝な
　目的のためではない」
dialogues.en: "It's weird? Really......"
dialogues.text: "It's weird? Really......"

dialogues.speaker: Suginami
dialogues.jp: 「じゃあ、何のためだ？」
dialogues.en:
He murmurs quietly. He keeps looking straight forward and I
can't read his expression.
dialogues.text:
He murmurs quietly. He keeps looking straight forward and I
can't read his expression.

dialogues.speaker: Suginami
dialogues.jp: 「強いて言うなら、世のため、人のためだな」
dialogues.en: "I mean, I know I don't do this a lot."
dialogues.text: "I mean, I know I don't do this a lot."

dialogues.jp: 俺は頭を抱えた。また、わけのわからんことを。
dialogues.en:
"......Anyway, so you want to know how to cheer her up,
right?"
dialogues.text:
"......Anyway, so you want to know how to cheer her up,
right?"

dialogues.jp: 拳を固く握り、杉並が力説する。
dialogues.en:
I cross my arms and cock my head to think. But I can't think
of anything......
dialogues.text:
I cross my arms and cock my head to think. But I can't think
of anything......

dialogues.speaker: Suginami
dialogues.jp:
「水越の落ち込んでいる謎を解明して、人々に
　面白い話題を提供できれば、大いなる意義が
　あろうというもの」
dialogues.en:
"You are a close friend of hers, so I thought you could come
up with a good idea."
dialogues.text:
"You are a close friend of hers, so I thought you could come
up with a good idea."

dialogues.jp: 俺はひとり納得した。
dialogues.en: "Hey, I'm not close friends with Mako."
dialogues.text: "Hey, I'm not close friends with Mako."

dialogues.speaker: Suginami
dialogues.jp:
「というわけで、水越をどこに誘うか考えてい
　るのだが、今ひとつ候補が絞り込めんのだ。
　おまえ、何かいいアイデアはないか？」
dialogues.en: "You aren't?"
dialogues.text: "You aren't?"

dialogues.jp: 腕を組み、首を傾げる。
dialogues.en: "I'm not."
dialogues.text: "I'm not."

dialogues.speaker: Suginami
dialogues.jp:
「仲のいいお前なら、何かいい案が出てくるか
　と思ったんだが」
dialogues.en: "Okay."
dialogues.text: "Okay."

dialogues.jp: ｛のうり／脳裡｝にふと、アイデアが｛ひらめ／閃｝いた。
dialogues.en: "So I am not sure if this is a good idea, but......"
dialogues.text: "So I am not sure if this is a good idea, but......"

dialogues.jp: 「プロレスを観に行くとかは？」
dialogues.en:
"What about taking her to watch a pro wrestling match
together?"
dialogues.text:
"What about taking her to watch a pro wrestling match
together?"

dialogues.speaker: Suginami
dialogues.jp: 「プロレス？　……気は確かか？」
dialogues.en:
"Pro wrestling? ......Would that really work to cheer her
up?"
dialogues.text:
"Pro wrestling? ......Would that really work to cheer her
up?"

dialogues.jp: 杉並が、｛うさん／胡散｝臭そうな目で俺を見る。
dialogues.en:
"I think she likes those things. She may like 'KE-1' as
well."
dialogues.text:
"I think she likes those things. She may like 'KE-1' as
well."

dialogues.speaker: Suginami
dialogues.jp:
「ふむ。格闘技系か。言われてみれば、水越は
　血の気が多そうだし、映画よりもそっちの方
　が意外といいかもしれんな」
dialogues.en: "The kick boxing?"
dialogues.text: "The kick boxing?"

dialogues.speaker: Suginami
dialogues.jp:
「そういうの観て、スカッとしたあとなら、勢
　いで話すかもしれないだろ」
dialogues.en:
"She might feel refreshed if she watches something like
that."
dialogues.text:
"She might feel refreshed if she watches something like
that."

dialogues.speaker: Suginami
dialogues.jp:
「……なるほど。それなりに検討する余地は、
　ありそうだな」
本当に検討しているのか、杉並が黙り込む。
dialogues.en: He looks like he's thinking about it, and he's all quiet.
dialogues.text: He looks like he's thinking about it, and he's all quiet.

dialogues.jp: しばらくして、俺が先に口を開いた。
dialogues.en: And I say to him,
dialogues.text: And I say to him,

dialogues.jp: 「なあ、今度は、俺が｛たず／訊｝ねてもいいか？」
dialogues.en: "Hey, can I ask you something?"
dialogues.text: "Hey, can I ask you something?"

dialogues.speaker: Suginami
dialogues.jp: 「何をだ？」
dialogues.en: "What?"
dialogues.text: "What?"

dialogues.speaker: Suginami
dialogues.jp:
「家で暇している女の子には、暇つぶしのため
　に何をあげたらいいと思う？」
dialogues.en:
"What do you think I can do to make a girl not bored when
she's always bored at home?"
dialogues.text:
"What do you think I can do to make a girl not bored when
she's always bored at home?"

dialogues.speaker: Suginami
dialogues.jp:
「暇つぶし？　それはもちろん、雑誌“ヌー”
　だな。男女を問わず、これがイチオシ」
dialogues.en:
"Bored girl at home? Of course the answer is the magazine
called Nu."
dialogues.text:
"Bored girl at home? Of course the answer is the magazine
called Nu."

dialogues.speaker: Suginami
dialogues.jp:
「……超能力やら心霊やら、はたまた宇宙人や
　ら杉並やらの、アレ？」
dialogues.en:
"......Are you talking about the magazine about supernatural
powers, ghosts, aliens, Suginami, etc?"
dialogues.text:
"......Are you talking about the magazine about supernatural
powers, ghosts, aliens, Suginami, etc?"

dialogues.speaker: Suginami
dialogues.jp:
「いつの間に俺が掲載されたのか知らんが、ま
　あ、そうだ」
dialogues.en:
"I didn't know when they put me on the magazine, but yes,
that's it."
dialogues.text:
"I didn't know when they put me on the magazine, but yes,
that's it."

dialogues.speaker: Suginami
dialogues.jp: 「本気か？」
dialogues.en: "Are you serious?"
dialogues.text: "Are you serious?"

dialogues.speaker: Suginami
dialogues.jp: 「何がだ？」
dialogues.en: "What do you mean?"
dialogues.text: "What do you mean?"

dialogues.jp:
きょとんとして訊ね返してくる。……奴はマジ
だ。
dialogues.en:
He asks me back as if there's nothing to laugh about.
......He's serious.
dialogues.text:
He asks me back as if there's nothing to laugh about.
......He's serious.

dialogues.speaker: Suginami
dialogues.jp:
「あれほど娯楽に徹した本はないぞ。“ヌー”
　さえあれば、半日は時の流れを忘れられる」
dialogues.en: "I can lose track of half a day with 'Nu'."
dialogues.text: "I can lose track of half a day with 'Nu'."

dialogues.speaker: Suginami
dialogues.jp: 「……お前はな」
dialogues.en: "......Dude, you are pathetic..."
dialogues.text: "......Dude, you are pathetic..."

dialogues.jp:
肩をすくめ、何となく舞い散る桜に目を向ける。
それっきり、二人ともだんまりだった。
dialogues.en:
I shrug my shoulders and look up at the petals of cherry
blossoms falling down. We stay silent all the way to school
afterwards.
dialogues.text:
I shrug my shoulders and look up at the petals of cherry
blossoms falling down. We stay silent all the way to school
afterwards.

dialogues.jp: （しかし……）
俺がプロレスで、杉並が“ヌー”。
dialogues.en: I came up with pro wrestlers and Suginami came up with "Nu".
dialogues.text: I came up with pro wrestlers and Suginami came up with "Nu".

dialogues.jp: およそ、女心にはうとい二人だよな……。
dialogues.en: We are out of touch with women's hearts......
dialogues.text: We are out of touch with women's hearts......

dialogues.jp: ◆見送りの表情◆
dialogues.en: ◆Junichi◆
dialogues.text: ◆Junichi◆

dialogues.jp:
頼子さんに見送ってもらうのも、今日で四度目
になる。彼女の切なげな笑顔が頭から離れなかっ
た。
dialogues.en: "Have a nice day."
dialogues.text: "Have a nice day."

dialogues.jp: 登校途中、相変わらずな杉並と出会う。

眞子を元気づける事に何故だか躍起になってい
る杉並だが、俺に案を求められても……。
dialogues.en: "What... is wrong?"
dialogues.text: "What... is wrong?"

dialogues.jp:
『プロレス』と『ヌー』、およそ女心には｛うと／疎｝い
二人だった。
dialogues.en: "Oh, it's nothing. Well, you have a nice day, too."
dialogues.text: "Oh, it's nothing. Well, you have a nice day, too."
